title: A spectral approximation with an error bar
promptMarkdown: For $f\in L^2(0,1)$ let $u=Gf$ and $u_N=\sum_{n=1}^N f_n(n\pi)^{-2}e_n$. Prove $\|u-u_N\|_2\le((N+1)\pi)^{-2}\|f\|_2$ and show the constant is sharp. For f=1 compute f_n, identify the exact classical solution, and explain why these two constructions agree.
hintLadder: Use Parseval for the tail and the largest inverse eigenvalue remaining.
Test the bound on a single omitted eigenfunction.
